newsitem.title: USA: Prudential lifts price targets on U.S. bank stocks.
newsitem.headline: Prudential lifts price targets on U.S. bank stocks.

text.p: Prudential Securities analyst Ruchi Madan said she raised target prices about 10 percent on a group of bank stocks and also published 1998 earnings estimates for the first time which forecast earnings gains of about 12 percent over 1997.
The analyst said Banc One Corp, which is her favorite in the group, remains a buy.
Other buy-rated bank stocks are Chase Manhattan Corp, Bank of New York Co Inc, BankBoston Corp, NationsBank Corp, Norwest Corp and KeyCorp.
